title: Vigil — vertical short (grade and fix, narrated)
outroFeats: Health · Docs · Best practices · Community standards · Fix PRs

lines.text: Too many repos to keep track of?
Vigil grades every GitHub repo you own, on one dashboard.
It checks the docs, best practices and community standards in each one.
Then it opens the pull request that fixes what's missing. One click.
Vigil. Keep watch over every repo.
